subject: SIG: Request for BYOK provenance manifest and HSM operator shift reconciliation

From: Oliver Brandt <oliver@cleargate.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: security@cleargate.com
Date: Fri, 22 Jul 2028 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: SIG/CAIQ follow-up — BYOK provenance + operator separation artifacts

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the SIG call earlier today. As we begin the vendor review for Cleargate's upcoming SOC 2 audit, our security team has a short set of artifacts they'd like to receive to satisfy a couple of CAIQ checks around key custody and operator controls. Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide the following for our tenant (tenant-id: CG-7841):

- BYOK provenance manifest (format: JSON preferred) that includes key creation timestamps, wrapping key IDs, and signing metadata.
- HSM operator shift logs for Q2 2028 showing operator handovers and custody events (redacted operator emails are fine; we need role/shift timestamps and audit IDs).
- Evidence of immutability for HSM archives (checksums + retention receipts) for the same period.
- Last key rotation timestamps and whether automated rotation was used.

For evidence delivery we prefer an SFTP drop or a secure Drive share. Ideally we need these artifacts by end of day Monday (US PST) to keep our audit schedule. If there are restrictions (e.g., any items that are never exported), please call those out and propose an alternative.

Two quick clarifying points from our side: 1) we do not need raw private key material, only provenance/metadata and audit logs; 2) if any artifacts are under a separate legal process (e.g., HSM vendor attestation), let us know how long procurement will take.

Appreciate the quick turn — feel free to loop in anyone else on your side.

Best,
Oliver
Oliver Brandt
Head of Vendor Security, Cleargate Financial
oliver@cleargate.com

Thanks — we can deliver the requested metadata and logs. I'll coordinate with Security Ops and the HSM team to produce a minimal export set that meets SIG/CAIQ expectations without exposing sensitive key material. Preliminary answers inline:

- BYOK provenance manifest: yes, we can provide a signed JSON manifest that contains creation timestamps, wrapping KEK IDs, and signature metadata. We will redact any internal operator service accounts.
- HSM operator shift logs: we can provide shift/hand-off records for Q2 2028 with operator role IDs and audit event IDs.
- Immutability evidence: we will produce cryptographic checksums and retention receipts for archived HSM exports.
- Rotation timestamps: will include last automatic and manual rotation events for tenant CG-7841.

Plan / timeline: Kimberly, can you pull the Q2 shift logs and build the tarball? Marissa, please prepare the packaging index and signed manifest. I will review and then provide an SFTP link for Cleargate. Target delivery: Monday EOD PST, but will update if anything needs legal redaction or vendor attestation time.

Oliver — quick question: do you need the manifest signed with Redwood's key or is a signed statement from the security team sufficient for your auditor?

Thanks,
Soojin
